headline: Gold bounces to ~4,060 ahead of Fed; daily trend still down
summary: Spot rebounded from 3,975 (Oct 23 low, lowest since July) to ~4,060 in early Asia.
Fed expected to HOLD at 3.75-4.00% tonight (hike odds ~7%), but Dec hike odds ~84%.
Chair Warsh press conference is the key signal; hawkish tone = pressure on gold.
Price below 20D and 100D MA, RSI ~41: rallies are being sold into resistance.
PCE inflation Thu; softer oil eases inflation fears, mild support for gold.
events: Thu 19:30 BKK  US Q3 GDP + Sep PCE
invalid: Daily close above 4,145 cancels the bearish view (next 4,220)
risk_note: Avoid new entries 30 min around FOMC and PCE. Not financial advice.
